# Thunderbird Mail Interface Description

## Top Bar

- **Application Name**: "Thunderbird Mail" displayed in the top-left corner.
- **Date and Time**: "Oct 23 00:21" centered in the top bar.
- **System Tray Icons**: Located on the right side of the top bar.
  - A bell icon indicating notifications.
  - A grid of system icons including:
    - Network connectivity.
    - Sound/volume control.
    - Power button.
- **Window Control Buttons**: On the far right of the top bar.
  - Minimize button (horizontal line).
  - Maximize button (square).
  - Close button (X).

## Left Sidebar (Folder Pane)

- **Application Icon**: A blue envelope icon at the top of the sidebar.
- **Navigation Icons**: A vertical row of icons on the far left, representing various applications or functions:
  - Chrome browser icon.
  - Thunderbird Mail icon.
  - Calendar icon.
  - To-do list/checklist icon.
  - Chat icon.
  - VLC media player icon.
  - LibreOffice Writer icon.
  - LibreOffice Calc icon.
  - LibreOffice Impress icon.
  - GIMP icon.
  - File manager icon.
  - Software center icon.
  - Help icon (question mark).
  - Trash icon.
  - Settings gear icon.
  - Grid icon for application launcher.
- **Folder Structure**:
  - **Account**: "mathias.gadenzi@gmail.com" with an email icon.
  - **Local Folders**: A folder icon with a downward arrow indicating expandable content.
    - **Trash**: A trash can icon.
    - **Outbox**: An envelope icon.
    - **Important**: A folder icon, currently selected and highlighted in gray.

## Main Content Area

- **Folder Header**: "Important" with "0 Messages" displayed next to it.
- **Context Menu**: A dropdown menu is open, triggered by clicking the small arrow next to the "Important" folder header.
  - **Menu Title**: "Folder Modes".
  - **Menu Options**:
    - "Show 'Get Messages'" (checked with a checkmark).
    - "Show 'New Message'" (checked with a checkmark).
    - "Show Total Message Count".
    - "Show Folder Size".
    - "Hide Local Folders".
    - "Hide Folder Pane Header".

## Search and Filter Bar

- **Search Field**: A search bar with placeholder text "Search..." and keyboard shortcut "CTRL + K".
- **Quick Filter Button**: A button labeled "Quick Filter" with a filter icon.

## Right Panel (Welcome Screen)

- **Header**: "Welcome to FREEDOM" with the Thunderbird logo and "ESR" badge.
- **Main Text**: "Thunderbird is a gift from thousands of people like you. We hope you'll enjoy the productivity, privacy, and freedom they make possible and we invite you to become part of that gift to others."
- **Donate Button**: A blue button with a heart icon and text "Donate" with the subtitle "Help keep Thunderbird alive!".
- **Two Information Cards**:
  - **Card 1: "Free and Open Source"**:
    - Subtitle: "Thunderbird is now yours forever."
    - Description: "Thunderbird is developed openly and distributed freely. Our software license protects your right to use, modify, and share Thunderbird. Our mission is to protect your privacy and freedom."
    - Button: "Get Help" with a hand icon.
  - **Card 2: "Powered by Community"**:
    - Subtitle: "You can become part of our story."
    - Description: "Anyone can contribute to Thunderbird. By donating, translating, answering questions, suggesting features, reporting bugs, and more, you make Thunderbird better for yourself and the world."
    - Button: "Participate" with a document icon.
- **Feature Announcement**: "Want new features sooner? Learn about Thunderbird Release." with a hyperlink.

## Bottom Status Bar

- **Status Indicator**: "Done" displayed at the bottom left corner.
